title: Howling Spectral Canine
description: A black dog stands on a dark rocky outcrop, head tilted back with mouth open in a howl. Colorful glowing particles, rings, and dripping paint effects swirl around it in a stormy rain, with an umbrella visible in the background amid dark clouds and falling rain.
prompt: A large black dog stands on a wet rocky mound howling upwards with mouth wide open and red tongue visible, surrounded by swirling colorful glowing particles, rings and dripping paint in pink, yellow and gold, heavy rain falling, dark stormy sky with smoke and clouds, an umbrella floating in the background, cinematic lighting, moody and surreal atmosphere
